scientific_contract.decision: Do not retroactively make persisted gate/runtime provenance a scientific acceptance predicate for historical ADMITs. For new blocks, bind the exact frozen reserved-score runtime dependency digest into ADMIT before score generation; then a missing or mismatched RESERVE runtime binding is a predeclared authorization-contract violation and may fail closed.
scientific_contract.reason: Post-hoc provenance enforcement would change the acceptance predicate after evidence generation and could invalidate otherwise exact historical attempt evidence. Pre-score binding converts provenance from traceability metadata into an explicit authorization condition without rewriting history.
scientific_contract.reservation_payload_identity: unchanged; the existing reservation payload/digest and attempt identity remain scientific identity, while event-level runtime provenance is separately bound by the new ADMIT contract

scope_limitations: The validation used deterministic injected event/frame stubs and did not byte-execute the complete production sibling graph in one repository-local runtime.

The provenance-aware auditor is not yet wired into reservation_compliance_close_replay_2026-08-28.py; until a superseding CLOSE/replay path explicitly adopts it, the new predicate applies only to blocks executed through the new admission runtime and audited through the new auditor.
No multi-process writer lease/fencing claim is made.
